_comment_dataset_path: multicap_v2 adds 4,629 five-turn kernel-refinement trajectories (hkust-nlp/drkernel-coldstart-8k, MIT) to the 56,493-row base mix, lifting multi-turn coverage from 6.4% to 15.0%. v1 taught one-shot generation, but the 2026 frontier optimizes iteratively against execution feedback: Dr. Kernel warm-starts on exactly this shape before multi-turn RL, and Kernel-Smith trains a local improver rather than a one-shot generator. Filtered for contamination (0 hits), reward hacking (71 dropped above 50x, one claimed 1541x) and length (705 dropped that would truncate mid-refinement).
_comment_max_seq_length: 17408, not 16384: the math_reasoning CoT generator capped its traces at a ~16.8k budget that lands just ABOVE 16384, so that cut silently discarded 3,214 of 5,998 math rows (53.6% of the slice) versus 0.43% of kernels -- realizing about half the configured frac_math_reasoning. Measured max over the whole math slice is 16,808 tokens, so 17408 recovers every dropped row with none left above it. Costs ~54M tokens/epoch (+29%).
_comment_epochs_and_lr: Both were set for SFT from a BASE-like checkpoint. SFT now starts from the chat-vector model, which behaves like an instruction-tuned one, and 1e-5 for 3 epochs is how this project already destroyed instruction-following once (docs/EVAL_RESULTS.md: continued pretraining the instruct model at 1e-5 collapsed it). Losing that capability here would waste the entire point of the residual transfer. Tulu 3's full-SFT recipe -- the closest proven open comparison -- uses 5e-6 for 2 epochs with warmup 0.03 from a Llama base, and starting from an ALREADY aligned model warrants being gentler than that, not harsher. Two epochs over the larger v2 mix is also ~474M token-passes against v1's ~525M at three, so this costs no capacity: same compute, more diverse data, less forgetting risk.
_comment_save_total_limit: 1, not 2: two SFT runs share one filesystem. At limit=2 each peaks near 663GB during rotation (three 221GB checkpoints coexisting) and 2x that exceeds the volume. At limit=1 the peak is ~442GB. The cost is that a crash inside the rotation window loses the run, which the driver recovers by resubmitting; running out of disk mid-run costs both runs.
_comment_pathb: PATH B: the proven Dr. Kernel structure -- instruct model straight into SFT, NO continued pretraining. Identical data and hyperparameters to Path A; the only variable is the starting checkpoint, so the A/B answers whether midtrain earns its ~20 GPU-hours instead of us arguing about it. model_id stays Qwen/Qwen3-14B and the launcher is invoked with from-stage '-' so nothing overrides it.
